context.transcript:
Andersonville Office Superstore is happy to announce a new service.
More people have begun working from home recently, so we're now offering free home delivery to our corporate clients.
Your employees can expect to receive the same high-quality supplies and fast-dependable service that they've always had, but now at the convenience of their own doorstep.
How's that for an improvement?
To register for this new service, contact a sales representative.
They'll guarantee that any corporate discount is applied to all orders.
context.transcript_translation:
Andersonville Office Superstore 很高兴宣布一项新服务。
最近有更多人开始在家工作，因此我们现在为我们的企业客户提供免费送货上门服务。
您的员工可以期待收到与以往一样高质量的用品和快速可靠的服务，但现在可以在他们自己家门口享受了。
这算不算一次改进呢？
要注册这项新服务，请联系销售代表。
他们保证任何企业折扣都会应用于所有订单。
